statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail risk is low at 13% while Stress remains elevated at 55%; the Nasdaq-100 is trading a genuinely two-sided expiry-Friday session against a long-end bond market near multi-decade yield highs.
recommendation: Conditions are consistent with functioning mean reversion: today's session has already produced a full round trip and repeated retracements in both directions. A narrow evidence-based caution window is carried at 19:00Z-20:00Z, where August monthly options expiry concentrates closing and roll flow into the cash close. Existing-position management and emergency protection remain unaffected by this assessment.
headline: A round-trip expiry Friday: the Nasdaq-100 sold its open to 29,142.44, bought it all back, and printed a new high, leaving a two-sided tape despite a 4.74% 10-year.
body: Cash NDX trades near 29,325.73, about +0.39% against a 29,213.17 prior close. The session opened at 29,359.60, was faded to a 29,142.44 low, reclaimed the entire decline and has since printed a 29,405.12 session high; NQ September futures sit near 29,434.50, about +0.46%, inside a 29,220.75-29,539.00 range against a 29,300.50 prior close. That sequence is the central Tail evidence: pullbacks are being retraced in both directions rather than extending after failed retracements, which is the structure the pathological no-retracement path requires. Volatility confirms it, with VIX at 14.89, down 6.0% on the day and holding a 14.77-15.95 range. The stress side of the ledger is genuinely elevated. The 10-year yield is 4.74%, up 3.4bp, the 2-year 4.24%, up 4.2bp, and the 30-year 5.28%, up 2.8bp and still close to the 5.34% print that marked its highest level since 2007 earlier this week; Treasury's decision to double long-bond buybacks has slowed rather than reversed that move. Gold is up about 2.2% and bitcoin about 6%, a debasement-flavoured bid that sits alongside, not against, the equity rebound. Cross-asset internals conflict rather than align: five of eight tracked megacaps are higher while six of seven tracked semiconductors are lower, with ARM and INTC down more than 2%, so index strength is broad-but-shallow rather than a single-vector trend. August flash PMI was the day's catalyst and it has already been absorbed, with the composite at 56.0 against 53.2 expected and services at 56.8, the strongest since December 2024 - a growth surprise that pushed yields higher and is better read as a Stress and Confidence input than as evidence of a lethal price path. Oil remains an unresolved geopolitical channel with WTI near 86.58 and Brent near 93.91, supported by expectations of further US pressure on Iran. The one scheduled structural risk left today is the August monthly options expiration, whose closing and roll flow concentrates into the final cash hour at 19:00Z-20:00Z; that is carried as a narrow conditional window rather than a session-wide elevation. After the 20:00Z cash close, CME equity futures settle for the week at 21:00Z and do not reopen until Sunday evening, so most of the published horizon covers a closed market in which no mean-reversion-failure path can form.

lookbackSummary: Claude coverage over the past 24 hours is partial: nine hourly assessments are available (01:00Z, 06:00Z, 07:00Z, 08:00Z, 11:00Z, 12:00Z, 13:00Z, 14:00Z and 15:00Z) and the remaining fifteen clock-hours, covering the whole of the August 20 US afternoon and evening plus scattered overnight gaps, have no published assessment and are marked unavailable. Across the available hours the published Tail stayed in a narrow 12-16 band and the mapped policy state was green throughout. The shape of the series is informative: Tail sat at 12 through the Asian and European hours with Stress easing from 59 to 53 as the overnight session behaved, then stepped up to 14, 15 and 16 as the 13:45Z flash PMI approached and printed, with the dominant mode shifting to event/whipsaw at 14:00Z. The 15:00Z assessment already began the decay back to 14 as the release was absorbed and the opening-range low was reclaimed. Confidence improved steadily from 83 to 88 as live US-session evidence replaced overnight inference.
outlookSummary: The forecast holds the current hour at a low Tail while the two-way structure observed through the US morning continues to be confirmed, then eases gently through the early afternoon on the assumption that retracements keep appearing on both sides and long-end yields do not accelerate. One watch-level hour is carried at 19:00Z, where August monthly options expiry concentrates closing and roll flow into the 20:00Z cash close; that elevation is a scheduled-flow checkpoint rather than an observed structure, and it releases immediately afterwards. From 21:00Z the published horizon changes character entirely: CME equity index futures settle for the week and do not reopen until Sunday evening, so the remaining hours cover a closed market. With no live order book there is no mean-reversion dynamic that can fail, and conditional Tail therefore falls to a structural floor near 3-5% for the whole weekend stretch. Stress decays alongside it while Confidence steps down steadily from 88 to 62, reflecting an assessment carried progressively further from its last live observation rather than any adverse development. The unresolved conditional risks carried into next week are the long-end yield path, semiconductor breadth, and Middle East escalation, all of which would express as a Sunday reopen gap rather than as intraday structure inside this horizon.
